description: Use before Sunday lock for a kick-time checklist of outdoor weather games that need a look. Prefer this over get_flags when the user wants that checklist. Optional weekId (YYYY-wNN); omit it for the current week. Returns FLAG and WATCH games whose roof is outdoor, or retractable and confirmed open, sorted by kickoff. Skips DOME, CLEAR, and closed or fixed roofs. Each game includes matchup, call, confidence, kickoff time, a one-sentence why, and the game page URL.

weekId.description: Week id YYYY-wNN, for example 2026-w04. Regular season weeks are 1–18. Omit for the current week.

name: get_sunday_lock_sheet
title: Sunday lock sheet
